verdict.rationale: Claude Agent SDK is an agent-building framework (client role) that connects to external MCP servers (docs-5, docs-43, docs-44, docs-52) rather than exposing itself as an official MCP server for other agents to connect to; the 'in-process MCP server' feature (docs-47) is an internal mechanism for exposing custom tools to Claude itself, not a documented endpoint for external agents to connect via. Per the agent-role exclusion, this axis does not apply.
